description: Send raw keystrokes to a device shell (for interactive programs). Supports escapes: "\n" Enter, "\x03" Ctrl-C, "\x04" Ctrl-D, "\t" Tab, "\x1b" Esc, "\x1b[A" Up. Returns the current screen.

device.description: Device name (or unique substring of it) or device UUID, as shown by list_devices

keys.description: Keys to send; JSON-style escapes are interpreted

name: send_keys
